answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique Wattpad story readership. It works because stories read by strangers over three years, and the ferrous it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the zenith is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Time is the tax here: stories read by strangers over three years cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the oasis for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
